description: This file contains utility functions for accessing component and category data stored in local JSON files. It provides methods to retrieve all components, find components by ID or category, list categories, and get featured components, without any network activity.

methods.name: getAllComponents()
methods.description: Returns an array containing all component objects available in the local registry.

methods.name: getComponentById(id)
methods.description: Finds and returns a component object with the specified id; returns undefined if not found.

methods.name: getComponentsByCategory(categorySlug)
methods.description: Filters and returns components belonging to a specific category slug.

methods.name: getCategories()
methods.description: Returns an array of category objects, each with name, slug, and description.

methods.name: getFeaturedComponents(limit = 6)
methods.description: Returns a set of featured components up to a specified limit; defaults to first six if no featured marked.
